name: Besan Masala Roti
ingredients: 1 teaspoon dry pomegranate seeds (anardana) or amchur
instructions: 1. In a large mixing bowl, combine wheat flour, gram flour, chopped onion, green chili, coriander, ajwain, turmeric, red chili powder, salt, and ghee.
2. Gradually add warm water to knead a firm, smooth dough and let it rest for 15 minutes.
3. Divide the dough into equal portions and roll them into thick, round discs.
4. Heat a tawa (griddle) over medium heat and place the roti on it.
5. Cook both sides until golden brown spots appear, applying a little ghee or butter.
6. Serve hot with a dollop of white butter (makkhan) or spicy mango pickle.
description: Besan Masala Roti is a staple breakfast or meal in Haryanvi households. Known for being hearty and nutritious, it reflects the agrarian lifestyle of the state, traditionally served with a generous helping of homemade white butter or curd, providing energy for long days of physical labor.
